correctness.rationale: For G=K_{m,m}∨K_c, m≥3,c≥1, N=2m+c, edge count m²+2mc+C(c,2), rho=E/C(N,2). Triangle sums over opposite shore and universal clique give U≤min(2(m−1)u/m,(m−1)v/c), then U/(u+v+w)≤2(m−1)/(m+2c). Metric witness assigns 2 within a shore, 1 across shores/clique, 0 collapsed clique, saturating. Real-L1 maps integrate scalar threshold cuts. Nonedge crossings H=x(m−x)+y(m−y), e=s(N−s)−H; minimize e at z=0 or c, complement z=c. With λ=(m−1)/(m+c−1), F=H−λe, F(x+1,y+1)−F(x,y)=−2(1−λ)(x+y), axis F<0, yielding unique nontrivial optimal (1,1,0) and complement. Thus gamma_met=rho(3m+2c−2)/(m+2c), gamma_L1=rho(2m+c−2)/(m+c−1), ratio gap (m−1)(m−2)/((m+2c)(2m+c−2)). Independent exact count checked m3..8,c1..4; general theorem from algebra.
